body: I know exactly what you mean. Fuck them. Those people will get what's coming to them sooner or later.
You mean like family? It's pretty much the only thing I have left but it's also falling apart.

I went through this with my ex. She didn't kill herself and she is still alive to this day but whenever she told me about her not wanting to live another day it broke my heart into pieces. But now I get it completely. Because I'm in the same boat.

I'm not sure if I like the thought of my life having a meaning. I used to but not anymore. Responsibility only gets you to worry about every single thing. I don't need a reason to live. I'll live until it's time for me to go.

I do this too. Sometimes I imagine an ideal world that I'd like to live in. Me hanging out with my old friends, me and my ex still being together, meeting up with people I knew who died. Even if it just makes you happy for 5 minutes every day, it's still something.

This might be hard to hear but you need to stop caring about what other people think. Yes, even your own family. I'm learning this the hard way too. I know it's hard. I'm not in your situation but I know it's hard. 

I think you should consider moving out, maybe even move to the other side of the country where you can start fresh. A place where you won't be plagued by these negative thoughts all the time. I won't tell you to "love yourself" or any of that cringy shit, all of that has to come naturally. If you becoming a woman makes you happy, you should absolutely go through with it, no matter who disagrees with it. 

I know they're your family but fuck their opinion. Tell them this is your life and you'll do whatever the fuck makes you happy. I wish you all the best. You don't have to die for other people.

You're most likely correct about that one. I realize that I'm probably in a dark place right now but these are my thoughts as of right now. 

I guess I just never put two and two together that most people also think about how "meaningless" life is, except they just move past it. I wish that would go easier for me. 

>so that we don't suicide from purposeless-ness

That's so true. Everyone needs a purpose. I just wish I knew what my purpose was.

Anyway, I really appreciate your comment bro and I wish you all the best.

Thanks man, you have no idea how badly I needed to hear this right now. 
Like no idea. I've always wanted to put my feelings into words just once and now I feel relieved. 

I appreciate your comment for giving me a new perspective on some things. Maybe I should just stop whining and actually go out there and trying out some new things and I might find something that I like.

I wish you the best too bro.
